updates.text: Talib re-routed Nicks on recorded press reps and lost others to Nicks's hands. Both results belong in the evaluation; a mixed practice sample does not determine every coverage matchup.
updates.source: Source: [dated camp observations](career/2014/Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Training_Camp/training_report.md). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

updates.text: Fifty-eight defensive snaps outside with the interception of Luck's third-and-long throw for Allen at the Jacksonville 23 at 9:14 of the third quarter, returned 1, two snaps after the breakup of the first-down throw for Allen on the same drive; four tackles and three passes defended, the third the breakup of the throw for Moncrief at the end of the third quarter. The play-by-play names him as the tackler on Hilton's 12-yard catch on the opening drive and on three Richardson runs and does not record the coverage on any Indianapolis completion, so the leverage and help rules on Hilton and Wayne have one game's result and no cause attached. A head/neck injury, minor, was logged at the end of Indianapolis's touchdown drive at 8:02 of the fourth quarter; he was removed, the receipt recording Verner as the replacement in his slot by the chart's order with no pause recorded, and he is on an independent medical hold: projected return September 25, reassessment September 22 ([medical record](career/2014/Team_Operations/Medical/incidents/aqib_talib_2014-09-21.md)). Indianapolis scored twice more after he left, 66 yards in eight plays and 85 in nine; the play-by-play does not say who covered Hilton on the 10-yard touchdown or Wayne on the fourth-and-10 40-yarder. No football finding attaches to the hold.
updates.source: Source: [Week 3 game record](career/2014/Regular_Season/Games/Week_03/output.md) and its public receipt. This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

updates.text: His independent medical hold was reassessed Monday with no change and released Thursday, September 25, his projected date; Ball took the outside work in the packet's Talib-out picture Monday and Wednesday. Full Thursday and Friday and in the Saturday walkthrough, outside opposite Verner in the Dime and Nickel periods with Bouye at nickel, the packet's Talib-in secondary. Nothing charged to him on the recorded reps. Starts at San Diego by Stone's decision on the clearance; no designation on the Friday report.

short.text: Aqib Talib signed with Jacksonville in March 2014 as a physical outside corner the staff judged above the NFL starting standard in nearly every part of his game. His best tools are press coverage, ball skills and play at the catch point, and the staff believes he can challenge bigger receivers, with consistent technique still important to that matchup; in camp he re-routed Hakeem Nicks on some press reps and lost others to Nicks's hands. Tackling in run support, getting off blocks and penalty discipline are the weakest parts of his game, though still at a starting standard. In {{2014.regular.games:words}} games this season he has {{2014.regular.tackles}} tackles and {{2014.regular.passes_defended:words}} passes defended, including a September interception of Andrew Luck against Indianapolis.

transactions.text: Signed a five-year contract with Jacksonville (2014 to 2018)
